characters.name: Aaron
characters.description: Moses' older brother, man in his eighties but sturdy, a bit shorter and broader than Moses, long full grey beard, bushy grey eyebrows, warm smiling brown eyes, olive skin, sand-colored wool robe with a dark-red sash, white head cloth, holds a smooth almond-wood staff

characters.name: Moses
characters.description: tall slender man about 80 but strong, long brown beard with first streaks of grey, kind deep-set brown eyes, a little shy expression, olive skin, undyed cream wool robe with a brown striped mantle, brown head cloth, plain wooden shepherd's staff

characters.name: Pharaoh
characters.description: Egyptian king, middle-aged, stubborn and grumpy but comical, not scary, bronze skin, clean-shaven, heavy kohl eyes, tall blue-and-gold striped nemes headdress topped by a small gold cobra crown, long white pleated robe covering shoulders, wide gold collar, gold crook staff

cover.prompt: Aaron and Moses stand side by side in Pharaoh's grand columned throne hall, calm and polite, Aaron holding up his staff. On the throne Pharaoh sits with arms crossed and a grumpy pout, while a small green frog sits right on top of his crown and dozens of cheerful frogs hop across the shiny floor. Warm light through tall columns, funny and friendly mood, wide shot.

pages.prompt: Portrait of Aaron standing in front of a simple tent in the land of Goshen, holding his almond-wood staff, mouth open mid-speech as if speaking clearly and confidently, one hand raised. His long grey beard catches the morning sun. Sheep and mud-brick houses behind. Friendly medium shot, Aaron as the clear focus.

Moses and Aaron sit together on a low stone outside a tent. Moses touches his own lips with a worried, shy look; Aaron puts a big warm hand on his brother's shoulder and smiles encouragingly. A soft warm light from above falls gently on both of them, no figure in the sky. Intimate two-shot, evening glow.

Moses and Aaron, looking small, walk toward Pharaoh's enormous palace with towering painted columns and giant stone statues. Aaron takes a deep breath, chest raised, staff in hand; Moses walks close beside him. Low camera angle making the palace huge and the brothers brave. Bright midday sun, long shadows.

Close-up of Pharaoh on his golden throne, arms folded tightly, lips pushed out in an exaggerated stubborn frown, nose in the air, eyes looking away. Funny, childish expression. Fan-bearers' feathers in the background, blue and gold palace colors. Moses and Aaron stand small and calm at the bottom of the throne steps.

At the bank of the Nile, Aaron raises his staff high over the river, and the water has turned a bright raspberry-juice red, shimmering and clear like syrup. Moses stands beside him, watching the river with a tender, thankful expression. Egyptians on the far bank stare at the red water with jugs in hand, puzzled. No dead fish. Wide scene, morning light.

Aaron lifts his staff over the Nile and a fountain of cheerful green frogs leaps out of the water in big arcs, mouths open as if croaking, dozens of them flying toward the shore. Aaron looks surprised and amused. Splashes, sparkling droplets, playful energy. Dynamic wide shot from the riverbank.

Funny scene inside Pharaoh's palace: frogs everywhere. A frog on Pharaoh's pillow in his big bed, one peeking out of a clay bread oven, one sitting in a bowl of dough, frogs on the steps and tables. Pharaoh stands in the middle with a horrified comical face, and one tiny frog sits proudly on top of his crown. Bright, humorous, crowded composition.

Pharaoh, covered with a few frogs, throws his arms up and shouts 'Enough!' at Moses and Aaron. On the right, Moses stands with raised open palms and closed eyes in calm prayer, and the frogs are hopping away in a long line out the door. Pharaoh already has a sly, stubborn look returning. Wide throne-room shot.

Aaron strikes the dusty ground with his staff and a little puff of dust rises. Around the palace courtyard, Egyptian officials and Pharaoh himself are all scratching comically: heads, ears, a beard of a courtier, Pharaoh scratching under his headdress with his crook. Tiny dots in the air, no bugs drawn large. Humorous, lively group scene.

Split landscape: on the left, over Egyptian fields, a dark grey sky drops round little ice balls with sparkling streaks of orange light inside them, bouncing on rooftops, while Egyptians peek out of doorways. On the right, the land of Goshen lies peaceful under a clear blue sky, Hebrew children playing and sheep grazing in sunshine. A clear line between the two skies. No damage, no injured people.

Moses and Aaron walk once again up the long palace steps, calm and dignified, side by side, Aaron's staff in hand. Faint repeated footprints on the steps suggest many visits. Their faces are patient and polite, not angry. Morning light, the palace doors open ahead of them. Medium-wide shot from behind and a little to the side.

Evening on a hill above the Hebrew houses of Goshen. Aaron stands with his staff, looking toward the far-off palace with a quiet, hopeful smile; Moses stands beside him. The sky is turning from orange to soft blue, and a first bright star shines. Families light lamps below. Peaceful, hopeful wide shot.

Aaron kneels down to the eye level of the viewer, smiling warmly, one hand on his staff and the other open in an encouraging gesture. A single friendly little green frog sits on the tip of his staff. Soft warm background of a tent and a sunset. Close, inviting framing.
